description: Estimate the effort of the current, given, or all unestimated task plans as T-shirt sizes (XS, S, M, L, XL) of expected human time, and store it in the "Effort:" frontmatter key, or calibrate the estimation against the actual human time of the finished tasks. Use when the user wants to "estimate", "size", or "gauge the effort" of a "task" or "plan", or to "calibrate" the effort estimation.
